name: Postcard Collage
description: A 22-second trip film on black: tall strips appear behind you, the place's name shuffles into big red letters, 59 fast postcards flash through an opening band, and the finale turns bands into cards, a grid and a closing panorama.

inputs.label: Trip clips and photos
inputs.hint: 12 or more works best. Start with a wide shot of you looking at the view; clips of 8 seconds or longer suit the finale.

params.label: Cut the person out in front of the strips

agentHints: Fixed 22.1 s film. Your picks are the order clips are cast in: 1st the opener (a wide, steady shot with the user standing or walking in it, head and most of the body in frame), then the closer (the most beautiful wide shot, golden light or water), then two more wide videos (top band, middle band), then six clips with something tall in the middle (person, tower, tree, doorway; portrait clips suit these), then three details (food, signs, markets). Every clip also flashes by as a postcard. Keep the place to its name, 18 characters at most.
